_comment: Chapter 08's own calls: GET only, with the least-privileged Graph permission from the Learn page for the call, read on October 30, 2026. The evidence run also makes Chapter 01's inventory calls and Chapter 02's emergency-access calls, which stay declared in calls.json; Get-PaEvidencePermission returns the union of all three tasks. Tests fail when a call is made that isn't listed.

calls.note: Filtered by activityDateTime (ge, le), loggedByService (eq) and activityDisplayName (eq), the filters the directoryAudit resource page lists for those properties. Directory.Read.All is the higher-privileged alternative and is never requested.
